mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_personal_task (owner_id, title, source_group_id, source_message_id) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{title}, #{sourceGroupId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{sourceMessageId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.completed, t.created_at, CASE WHEN gm.id IS NOT NULL THEN t.source_group_id END AS source_group_id, CASE WHEN gm.id IS NOT NULL THEN t.source_message_id END AS source_message_id FROM im_personal_task t LEFT JOIN im_group_member member ON member.group_id = t.source_group_id AND member.user_id = #{ownerId} LEFT JOIN im_group_message gm ON gm.id = t.source_message_id AND gm.group_id = t.source_group_id AND gm.id > member.joined_after_id AND gm.recalled_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_personal_task WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND completed = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_personal_task WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND completed = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE im_personal_task SET completed = #{completed} WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM im_personal_task WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND id = #{id}
